# ArtifactFlow

> ArtifactFlow is an open-source, self-hosted, model-agnostic workspace for AI-generated artifacts, shared by people and authorized AI clients through MCP.

AI work can be scattered across chats, local files, providers, and people. ArtifactFlow preserves the output, not the conversation. It keeps authoritative source or retained original bytes, immutable content versions, searchable content, ownership, permissions, safe previews, and audit history. It does not run agents, call external AI APIs, automatically import chats, or provide vector search. MCP compatibility does not imply an official provider integration. It is not agent memory, a chat archive, or an AI generator.

The current public alpha supports Markdown pages with Mermaid diagrams, self-contained HTML artifacts, normalized PNG/JPEG images, and default-off native-text PDF, typed XLSX, and searchable DOCX artifacts. It searches authoritative or bounded derived text and metadata, keeps retained versions, and exposes approved format-specific read and write operations through scoped MCP access. PDF, XLSX, and DOCX require explicit enablement of their isolated processor boundaries; DOCX additionally requires independent validation by the PDF processor, while PDF OCR remains later work. Untrusted HTML executes only on a separate cookieless artifact origin; image uploads retain only normalized pixels, XLSX preview receives only a typed visible-cell manifest, and DOCX preview receives only a validated passive PDF derivative. The security page and threat model document these boundaries and their residual risks.

Team sharing follows live workspace roles and page overrides. Narrow external shares are revocable expiring or one-time page links, not a public catalog. Version history follows configured retention limits. Producer claims can be partial and remain self-reported. The product is alpha and has not received an independent security audit.

## Product

- [Home](https://artifactflow.app/): Product overview, current screenshots, capabilities, alpha status, and project boundaries.
- [Artifact workflow](https://artifactflow.app/workflow/): An artifact moves from creation to team search, authorized MCP retrieval, and new retained versions as models change.
- [Security architecture](https://artifactflow.app/security/): Two-origin isolation, sandbox and CSP controls, signed previews, defense in depth, and residual risks.
- [MCP server](https://artifactflow.app/mcp/): Current text and binary operations, Office read boundaries, token scopes, authority limits, untrusted-data envelopes, and write safeguards.
- [Self-hosting](https://artifactflow.app/self-hosting/): Local evaluation and production requirements for origins, runtime roles, PostgreSQL, storage, secrets, and mail.
- [Product roadmap](https://artifactflow.app/roadmap/): Current alpha boundary, default-off document formats, required production proof, later candidates, and explicit non-promises.

## Guides

- [What is an AI artifact vault?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/ai-artifact-vault/): A practical definition, essential properties, current ArtifactFlow scope, and links to lifecycle evidence.
- [How should AI-generated HTML run safely?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/safe-ai-generated-html/): The two-origin boundary, sandbox and CSP layers, advisory scanning, and documented residual risks.
- [Where should AI-generated artifacts live?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/ai-artifact-storage/): A comparison of AI chat, shared drives, Git, static hosting, and a versioned artifact vault.

## Repository documentation

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow): Source code, installation instructions, license, and project status.
- [Artifact lifecycle](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow/blob/main/docs/ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE.md): Authoritative identity, immutable-version, draft, metadata, and format-specific document-payload semantics.
- [Threat model](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow/blob/main/THREAT-MODEL.md): Security boundaries, attacker cases, maintained controls, and documented residual risks.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Supported versions and vulnerability reporting process.
- [Operations guide](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): Production configuration, deployment, backup, restore, and release operations.
